row:
Hi, I'm Trevor E. Carlson, a pediatric physical therapist and foster parent. I have over 15 years of experience as a physical therapist and over ten years as a foster parent.

Trying to figure out if your baby is behind? Want an expert's guidance for your baby's movement and development?

On this channel you'll find simple, clear videos about tummy time, rolling, sitting, crawling, pulling to stand, walking, and other baby developmental milestones and gross motor skills.

I'll help you understand what your baby is doing, what to work on next, and when something may need a closer look. All so you can guide your baby's development and become the confident parent you always knew you could.
